doc.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023

title: Lakers and Celtics talk; goodbye
summary: Closing banter about Lakers and Celtics, Magic and Bird, then thanks and goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
